# VIP Taxi Service KSA

> Private taxi and limousine transfers between Makkah, Madinah and Jeddah for Umrah/Hajj pilgrims, families, and tourists.

## About

VIP Taxi Service KSA (Google Business Profile: "VIP TAXI KSA") provides door-to-door private car transfers across the three holy-city corridor of Saudi Arabia. The service is hotel-to-hotel with no hidden fees. Rated 4.8 stars on Google (35 reviews).

Phone / WhatsApp: +966 53 972 0003
Website: https://viptaxiserviceksa.com

## Key routes (approximate, verified by drivers)

- Jeddah Airport → Makkah: ~85 km, 1–1.5 hours depending on traffic
- Makkah → Madinah: ~430 km, 4–5 hours by road
- Makkah → Jeddah Airport: ~85 km, 1–1.5 hours
